title: DetectorEngine — peak/RMS blend, attack/release ballistics, CMakeLists
description:
Implement DetectorEngine (peak/RMS blend, detector attack/release ballistics, log level) and be the sole CMakeLists.txt owner for phase B DSP + detector tests registration.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md section 6 (peak/RMS, ballistics, log level) — detector vs audible gain ballistics are SEPARATE
- Source/DSP/KeySourceRouter.* and KeyConditioner/PowerlineShield.* headers from b.1/b.2 for include/link expectations
- Existing CMakeLists.txt target_sources / test target patterns from phase A

Implement Source/DSP/DetectorEngine.h/.cpp:
- Peak: P[n] = max(|x[n]|, alpha_p * P[n-1])
- Power/RMS: R²[n] = alpha_r * R²[n-1] + (1-alpha_r)*x²[n]; R[n]=sqrt(R²[n]+eps)
- Combined envelope: E[n] = w_p * P[n] + (1-w_p) * R[n]
- Attack/release ballistics on the detector envelope (NOT audible gain):
  when |x| > Eprev: alpha_a; else alpha_r; alpha = exp(-1/(fs*tau))
- Log level: L[n] = 20*log10(E[n]+eps) for stable dB-domain thresholds
- prepare/reset/process mono key samples → linear envelope and dB level; realtime-safe
- Optional hooks to accept pre-conditioned key and/or hum-immunity adjusted energy without owning those classes' internals

Update CMakeLists.txt ONLY as phase-B sole owner:
- Add KeySourceRouter.cpp, KeyConditioner.cpp, PowerlineShield.cpp, DetectorEngine.cpp to the plugin/library target_sources
- Register tests/DetectorTests.cpp on the existing test executable/target (file may be filled in b.4)
- Do not restructure unrelated targets or phase A sources beyond additive target_sources/test entries

Do NOT implement the unit test body (b.4). Do NOT modify PluginProcessor wiring beyond what is strictly required to compile target_sources lists (prefer no PluginProcessor edits).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: DetectorEngine implements peak detector P[n]=max(|x[n]|, alpha_p*P[n-1])
DetectorEngine implements RMS/power path R² recursion and R=sqrt(R²+eps)
DetectorEngine applies separate attack/release alphas alpha=exp(-1/(fs*tau)) on the detector envelope only
CMakeLists.txt lists KeySourceRouter.cpp, KeyConditioner.cpp, PowerlineShield.cpp, and DetectorEngine.cpp on the plugin/library target
CMakeLists.txt registers tests/DetectorTests.cpp on the test target
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: implement audible gain/gate ballistics in DetectorEngine

allowed: choose process sample-wise or block-wise with equivalent math
add CMake target_sources entries for all phase B DSP units and DetectorTests.cpp
keep detector ballistics fully separate from any future gain computer
forbidden: merge audible gain smoothing into DetectorEngine
